integrity: The local square-ideal criterion and exact geometric sums furnish the infinite proof; small finite-ring enumerations are only supplementary; no independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns normalized p-adic target densities, not integer-matrix solvability or root multiplicities; neither an effective convergence rate nor exhaustive prior-art uniqueness is claimed.
title: Exact \(p\)-adic square-image density for upper-triangular \(2\times2\) matrices
